Laurey 87926, T-Knob Melrose in Polished Chrome

The Polished Chrome Melrose T-Knob matches the Melrose Polished Chrome Cabinet Bar Pull for a complete, modern kitchen remodel. The Melrose Polished Chrome 2 Inch Pull has a sleek design and a beautiful finish color. This kitchen cabinet pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 87926 Melrose Polished Chrome T-Knob:

  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Length: 2"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.
